request: Original Ziran logos inspired by Go and Hare

proposals.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one original mascot logo proposal for the Ziran programming language. Inspired by the friendly, memorable animal identity of Go and the economical animal emblem of Hare, without copying either character or silhouette. One isolated whole animal above a beautifully spaced readable wordmark. Flat vector-friendly illustration, strong compact silhouette, very few intentional details, clear at small size. Cool jade green and lake blue, deep pine outline, a tiny muted light-orange accent if useful. Genuine transparent background. Text verbatim: "Ziran" — uppercase Z then lowercase i r a n, exact spelling, one word only. No extra labels, symbols, hidden Z geometry, code brackets, props, scenery, mockups, gradients, shadows, gloss, 3D, watermarks or existing mascot likenesses. Plenty of empty margin around the complete animal and wordmark. Subject: a compact swift bird, one graceful full-body side profile with a pointed swept-back wing, tiny beak and short forked tail, calmly perched on its own two tiny feet with no branch. Distinctive elegant natural bird silhouette. Style: bold cut-paper emblem with one clever negative-space cut distinguishing the folded wing, restrained humanist wordmark. Quiet confidence and simplicity.
proposals.visual_review: Complete animal and correctly spelled Ziran wordmark; concept artwork, not a vector production master.
